messages:
mina: sharing a new layout probe for the latency dashboard: small-time presets (15s/1m/5m) inline above heatmap, separate sampling toggle per-route, and an optional "expanded bucket" that shows top traces. mock: https://img.redwood.test/ux/presets-inline-expanded-bucket.png
oliver: nice comp. question: when we show top traces for a bucket, do we fetch those on hover or on click? fetching on hover could be noisy for large orgs.
mina: thinking click-to-expand for trace list, hover shows a lightweight tooltip with counts + sample rate. click loads traces into side panel.
tess: accessibility: click-to-expand must be keyboard actionable (Enter/Space) and the side panel needs focus management. also ARIA label for the sampling toggle: "Sampling override for route".
ben: copy nit: sampling toggle states should read "Auto (system)" and "Override: 1-in-5 (20%)" rather than just numbers. helps non-technical PMs.
mina: agreed. also adding small help text: "Overrides are temporary and scoped to this route unless pinned."
oliver: for the presets: 15s seems short for some workloads. Can we make presets adaptive? e.g., show 15s if overall range <= 5m, otherwise show 1m/5m/15m.
tess: adaptive presets are great. UX note: indicate adaptive mode via a tiny label: "auto presets" so users know it's contextual.
ben: heatmap color: current hot color ramps to #ff3b30 which fails contrast in tooltips. suggest reducing saturation and using a 1px stroke on hovered bucket.
mina: will adjust max hue and add 1px stroke. also proposing a subtle halo for keyboard focus (3px box-shadow in system focus color).
oliver: p95 label on charts: change tooltip to "95th percentile latency — higher is slower" and under it show "Based on: sampled / full" as a small line. avoids ambiguity.
tess: small a11y detail: ensure that the "Based on" line is not hidden from screen readers if visually collapsed. use sr-only styling for that info.
ben: interaction question: if a user pins an override sampling rate for a route, should we surface a banner: "Rate override active on this route" with quick undo? ops wants audit logs for pin actions.
mina: yes banner + undo + audit log. add a dismissible cheeky badge in top-right of panel for status.
oliver: animation: when expanding bucket to side panel, avoid sliding content that reflows the chart. prefer overlay panel that fades in (100ms) + slide 48px. respects reduced-motion.
tess: keyboard flow: when panel opens, focus the first trace item, Esc closes panel and returns focus to the bucket. record in AX checklist.
ben: mobile: compact view needs presets collapsed into a dropdown and the sampling toggle moved into route settings. can't crowd the toolbar.
mina: noted. also adding a small legend item: "Sampling: 1-in-N (X%) — indicates fraction of requests used to compute metrics".
oliver: QA for PR: keyboard nav, focus return, ARIA labels for presets & sampling, adaptive preset behavior, bucket hover perf (no >200ms hot path), color contrast verification, analytics event for overrides.
tess: copy tweak: change "top traces" to "Representative traces" in the UI to avoid implying completeness.
mina: love that. I'll update the mock, implement palette tweaks, and open a PR with screenshots + the QA checklist. tagging @oliver @tess @ben for review :sparkles:
